title: A Christmas Carol
description: On Christmas Eve the miser Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by the ghost of his partner Marley and three spirits, who show him his past, his present and his future, and wakes on Christmas morning a changed man.
source_title: A Christmas Carol in Prose; Being a Ghost Story of Christmas

cover.alt: Marley's ghost, in chains, faces Scrooge by his fire
cover.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Bah! Humbug!
elements.text: Scrooge refuses his nephew's dinner, his clerk's warmth and two gentlemen collecting for the poor.

image.alt: Two gentlemen collecting for the poor
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The face in the knocker
elements.text: Arriving home, Scrooge sees his dead partner's face in the door-knocker.

image.alt: Marley's face in the door-knocker
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Marley in chains
elements.text: Marley's ghost appears dragging a chain of cash-boxes and ledgers, and announces three spirits.

metadata.source_quote: "I wear the chain I forged in life," replied the Ghost.

image.alt: Marley's ghost, in chains, faces Scrooge by his fire
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Phantoms on the air
elements.text: From the window Scrooge sees the sky full of wailing ghosts who want to help the poor and no longer can.

image.alt: Phantoms in chains fill the air outside the window
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Old Fezziwig's ball
elements.text: The Ghost of Christmas Past shows Scrooge his lonely schooldays and the party his first master threw for his apprentices.

metadata.act: Stave II: The First of the Three Spirits

image.alt: Old Fezziwig's Christmas ball
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Belle
elements.text: The young Scrooge's fiancée releases him: money has taken her place.

metadata.act: Stave II: The First of the Three Spirits

image.alt: Belle releases young Scrooge: another idol has displaced me
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The life he did not have
elements.text: Scrooge sees Belle years later in a happy, noisy home full of children, the family that could have been his.

metadata.act: Stave II: The First of the Three Spirits

image.alt: Belle's happy home, the life Scrooge did not have
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Christmas in the streets
elements.text: The Ghost of Christmas Present walks Scrooge through London on Christmas morning, through snow and shops and cheerful crowds.

metadata.act: Stave III: The Second of the Three Spirits

image.alt: Christmas morning in the snowy streets of London
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The Cratchits' dinner
elements.text: Bob Cratchit's family share a small goose and a pudding. Tiny Tim, ill and on a crutch, may not live.

metadata.act: Stave III: The Second of the Three Spirits
metadata.source_quote: "God bless us every one!" said Tiny Tim, the last of all.

image.alt: The Cratchits' Christmas pudding
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Ignorance and Want
elements.text: Under the Spirit's robe crouch two starving children, the shadows of a society that will not look at them.

metadata.act: Stave III: The Second of the Three Spirits
metadata.source_quote: This boy is Ignorance. This girl is Want.

image.alt: Ignorance and Want beneath the Spirit's robe
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: A death nobody mourns
elements.text: A silent hooded phantom shows businessmen joking about a dead man and thieves selling his bed-curtains.

metadata.act: Stave IV: The Last of the Spirits

image.alt: Old Joe's shop: the dead man's bed-curtains
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The gravestone
elements.text: In a neglected churchyard Scrooge reads his own name on a stone and begs to know if the future can change.

metadata.act: Stave IV: The Last of the Spirits
metadata.source_quote: Are these the shadows of the things that Will be, or are they shadows of things that May be, only?

image.alt: The last Spirit points to the grave
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Christmas morning
elements.text: Scrooge wakes in his own bed, sends the biggest turkey to the Cratchits and goes to his nephew's for dinner.

metadata.act: Stave V: The End of It
metadata.source_quote: I don't know what day of the month it is!

image.alt: 'It's I, your uncle Scrooge. I have come to dinner'
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: A second father
elements.text: He raises Bob's salary and becomes a second father to Tiny Tim, who does not die.

metadata.act: Stave V: The End of It
metadata.source_quote: He became as good a friend, as good a master, and as good a man, as the good old city knew

image.alt: Scrooge raises Bob's salary
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Ebenezer Scrooge
elements.text: A rich, cold moneylender in the City of London who wants to be left alone, and finds out what that wish costs.

metadata.source_quote: secret, and self-contained, and solitary as an oyster.

image.alt: Marley's ghost, in chains, faces Scrooge by his fire
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Jacob Marley
elements.text: Scrooge's partner, seven years dead, who returns in chains to give him a chance he never had.

image.alt: Marley's ghost, in chains, faces Scrooge by his fire
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Bob Cratchit
elements.text: Scrooge's underpaid clerk, poor, cheerful and devoted to his family.

image.alt: Bob Cratchit slides on the ice in Cornhill
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Tiny Tim
elements.text: Bob's youngest son, small and ill, carried on his father's shoulder.

metadata.source_quote: "God bless us every one!" said Tiny Tim

image.alt: Bob carries Tiny Tim home from church
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Fred
elements.text: Scrooge's nephew, who keeps inviting him to Christmas dinner every year.

image.alt: Blind man's buff at Fred's Christmas party
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The Ghost of Christmas Yet to Come
elements.text: A silent, hooded phantom who only points.

image.alt: The last Spirit points to the grave
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Mr and Mrs Fezziwig
elements.text: Scrooge's first employer and his wife, who show what a master's generosity costs: almost nothing.

image.alt: Old Fezziwig's Christmas ball
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The counting-house
elements.text: A cold office in the City where Bob Cratchit works by a fire of one coal.

image.alt: Scrooge raises Bob's salary
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Scrooge's rooms
elements.text: Dark chambers that once belonged to Marley, where Scrooge eats gruel alone by a small fire.

image.alt: Scrooge checks his rooms: nobody there
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The Cratchits' house
elements.text: Four rooms in Camden Town, crowded and warm on Christmas Day.

image.alt: The Cratchits' Christmas pudding
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The churchyard
elements.text: A neglected burial ground, walled in by houses, overrun by weeds.

image.alt: The last Spirit points to the grave
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Three spirits and a deadline
elements.text: One night, three visitors, one bell at a time. The supernatural is a set of lessons with a clock.

image.alt: Phantoms in chains fill the air outside the window
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Early Victorian London
elements.text: Fog, workhouses, debtors' prisons and a booming City, in the hard winter of the 1840s.

image.alt: Christmas morning in the snowy streets of London
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Change through memory
elements.text: Scrooge is not argued out of his views. He is made to remember, and memory does the work.

image.alt: Old Fezziwig's Christmas ball
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Society's children
elements.text: Ignorance and Want are the products of a society that refuses responsibility for them.

image.alt: Ignorance and Want beneath the Spirit's robe
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The future is not fixed
elements.text: The book's question is whether the shadows Scrooge sees must happen, or only will if he keeps going the same way.

image.alt: The last Spirit points to the grave
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Fellow-passengers
elements.text: Fred's idea of Christmas: the one time people treat those below them as fellow-passengers to the grave.

image.alt: Blind man's buff at Fred's Christmas party
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The New Poor Law (1834)
elements.text: The workhouses Scrooge defends, built to make poor relief as harsh as possible.

image.alt: Two gentlemen collecting for the poor
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Malthus
elements.text: Thomas Malthus's population theory, behind Scrooge's phrase about the surplus population.

elements.title: Hamlet's father
elements.text: Dickens opens by insisting Marley is dead, as Hamlet's father must be dead, or nothing wonderful can follow.

image.alt: Marley's face in the door-knocker
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.
